describe.IPC.open: Returns a pair of connected `IPCPort`s for constructing the IPC duplex stream based on `bare-pipe`. Each port is transferable and can be sent to another thread or process before being connected.
describe.IPC: Returns a duplex stream using the provided `port`. See `bare-stream`'s `Duplex` (<https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-stream>) for the duplex stream API.
describe.incoming: The underlying `bare-pipe` `Pipe` used for reading. Read-only.
describe.outgoing: The underlying `bare-pipe` `Pipe` used for writing. Read-only.
describe.ref: Increase the reference count for the IPC to keep the event loop alive.
describe.unref: Decrease the reference count for the IPC to allow the event loop to exit.
describe.IPCPort: Constructs a port from a pair of file handles. The arguments are:
describe.connect: Returns an `IPC` connected to the `port` and marks the `port` as detached.
describe.detached: A boolean for whether the `port` is detached. A port becomes detached once it is connected or transferred, and a detached port cannot be transferred again.
